author: mryzhov
title: JS API E2E Electron cleanup fails on Windows - Permission denied removing locked electron.exe/dll
signature: rm cannot remove electron.exe Permission denied|Flaky Test
root_cause: The Electron process remains locked by the OS when the cleanup step runs, preventing deletion of electron.exe and related DLLs. This is a well-known Windows-specific flaky failure caused by race conditions between process teardown and file system release. The failure is unrelated to PR #37258 changes (JS action dependency bumps).
